title: Core Java
intro: Core Java interviews test the language features you use every day and the edge cases interviewers love. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with string handling (immutability, pool, StringBuilder — the #1 opener), then exception handling (checked vs unchecked, try-with-resources), then generics and wildcards (type erasure, PECS), I/O and NIO, and reflection and annotations. It closes with the comparison canon and scenario-based questions where the features combine.
